title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost for common workloads by providing safe defaults and automation for batching/caching and model quantization profiles, plus tooling to compute and surface unit economics to SREs and customers. This PR implements: 1) autotune service that proposes and applies batching/caching defaults per route/route-group, 2) quantization profile registry and auto-suggestion based on model/latency/cost tradeoffs, 3) unit-economics tooling (uecon) to estimate cost/token and cost/session for configured policies, and 4) docs + console wiring for showing recommendations. Work included integration tests, small runtime change to handle dynamic batching policy updates, and a migration script to backfill quant profiles for existing model entries. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and safety guardrails.
